components.name: Woodland oak
components.function: Ambient woodland ecology; visual reference for later reusable model
components.construction: One ordinary green woodland oak,18m proposedheight, wide rounded irregular crown, sturdy grey-brown fissured bark, spreading boughs and visible rootflare. Leaf-detail inset shows rounded lobes and a small acorn cluster. No gold leaves or blossom canopy. Whole tree fromrootfoot toallouterbranches, no garden surround.

components.notes: One ordinary green woodland oak,18m proposedheight, wide rounded irregular crown, sturdy grey-brown fissured bark, spreading boughs and visible rootflare. Leaf-detail inset shows rounded lobes and a small acorn cluster. No gold leaves or blossom canopy. Whole tree fromrootfoot toallouterbranches, no garden surround. Four named canopy forms are present with root feet, proposed heights and leaf/bark insets. Oak, birch, beech and multi-stem hazel are newly proposed woodland forms; GEN-09 supplies the rendering vocabulary, not these exact species models. Small canopy-outline insets are front silhouettes, not verified overhead crown plans. Leaf/nut interpretation, branch count, bark texture, backs and root contact need modelling review; they are not botanically validated specimens or seamless texture maps. Use local species mixtures, saplings and density changes rather than duplicate identical trees everywhere. Canopy/leaf geometry, alpha materials, wind, LOD and runtime performance remain unbuilt.
